---
title: "Creating Database"
---

# Installs

```{r import}
#install.packages("DBI")
#install.packages("RSQLite")

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Create Database
```{r make_database}
con <- dbConnect(
    SQLite(),
    "olist.db"
    )
```

# Adding tables to the Database
```{r add_tables}
#Reading in datasets
location <- read_csv("data/olist_geolocation_dataset.csv")
order_items <- read_csv("data/olist_order_items_dataset.csv")
order_payments <- read_csv("data/olist_order_payments_dataset.csv")
order_reviews <- read_csv("data/olist_order_reviews_dataset.csv")
orders <- read_csv("data/olist_orders_dataset.csv")
products <- read_csv("data/olist_products_dataset.csv")
customers <- read_csv("data/olist_customers_dataset.csv")
sellers <- read_csv("data/olist_sellers_dataset.csv")

#writing datasets to olist.db
dbWriteTable(con, "location", location)
dbWriteTable(con, "order_items", order_items)
dbWriteTable(con, "order_payments", order_payments)
dbWriteTable(con, "order_reviews", order_reviews)
dbWriteTable(con, "orders", orders)
dbWriteTable(con, "products", products)
dbWriteTable(con, "customers", customers)
dbWriteTable(con, "sellers", sellers)
```


Looking to see if there are any duplicate seller IDs. There are not. 
```{r clean}
duplicate_sellers <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM sellers
    GROUP BY seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
")

duplicate_sellers
```


Seller Revenue
```{r seller_revenue}
#A window function computes a value using data from multiple rows related to the current row, but unlike aggregate functions, it does not group rows into a single output. Instead, each row retains its identity. 
# In this case, we use window functions to get the cumulative total and the row index
# Multiplying by 1.0 forces decimal division. 

sellers_revenue <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    WITH sellers_grp AS(
        SELECT 
            SUM(price) AS revenue,
            oi.seller_id AS seller_id,
            seller_state AS seller_state
        FROM order_items AS oi LEFT JOIN sellers AS s
        ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
        GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    ), 
    cum_grp AS (
        SELECT 
            revenue,
            seller_id,
            1.0 * ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) / COUNT(*) OVER() as cum_sellers,
            1.0 * SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / SUM(revenue) OVER() AS cum_revenue,
            seller_state   
        FROM sellers_grp
    )
    SELECT 
        revenue,
        seller_id,
        cum_sellers,
        cum_revenue,
        CASE WHEN cum_sellers <= 0.2 THEN 'Top 20%' ELSE 'Bottom 80%' END AS top_seller,
        seller_state
        FROM cum_grp
")

saveRDS(sellers_revenue, "rds/sellers_revenue.rds")
dbWriteTable(con, "sellers_revenue", sellers_revenue, overwrite = TRUE)
```

Seller Revenue grouped by State

```{r state_revenue}

state_revenue <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    WITH ranked_states AS (
        SELECT 
            s.seller_state,
            sum(oi.price) AS total_revenue,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) ASC, seller_state ASC) AS state_seller_rank,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sum(oi.price) ASC) AS state_rank
        FROM order_items AS oi
        LEFT JOIN sellers AS s
            ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
        GROUP BY 
            s.seller_state
    )

    SELECT 
        SUM(sr.revenue) AS total_revenue,
        top_seller,
        state_rank,
        state_seller_rank,
        COUNT(*) AS total_sellers,
        CASE WHEN rs.state_seller_rank <= 10 THEN 'Bottom 10' ELSE sr.seller_state END AS seller_state_b
        FROM sellers_revenue AS sr LEFT JOIN ranked_states AS rs
        ON sr.seller_state = rs.seller_state
        GROUP BY seller_state_b, top_seller

")

saveRDS(state_revenue, "rds/state_revenue.rds")

```

Group by sellers, get freight data
```{r freight} 
freight <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    WITH freight_data AS(
        SELECT
            order_id,
            1.0 * (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp) / 86400 AS delivery_days,
            1.0 * (order_estimated_delivery_date - order_purchase_timestamp) / 86400 AS est_delivery_days
        FROM orders
    ),
    frght_grp AS(
        SELECT 
            AVG(delivery_days) AS delivery_days,
            AVG(est_delivery_days) AS est_delivery_days,
            seller_id,
            oi.order_id
        FROM order_items AS oi LEFT JOIN freight_data AS fd
        ON fd.order_id = oi.order_id
        GROUP BY fd.order_id, seller_id
    )
    SELECT
        AVG(delivery_days) AS delivery_days,
        count(delivery_days) AS n_deliveries,
        AVG(est_delivery_days) AS est_delivery_days,
        seller_id
    FROM frght_grp
    GROUP BY seller_id
")

```

Getting the reviews
```{r reviews}
reviews <- dbGetQuery(con,"
    WITH rvw_grp AS(
        SELECT 
            AVG(review_score) AS review, 
            seller_id,
            oi.order_id
        FROM order_items AS oi LEFT JOIN order_reviews AS o
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
        GROUP BY oi.order_id, oi.seller_id
    )
    SELECT
        AVG(review) AS avg_rvw,
        COUNT(review) AS n_rvw,
        seller_id
    FROM rvw_grp
    GROUP BY seller_id

")
```

Looking at order_items by seller
```{r order_items}
order_items <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
        COUNT(*) AS n_items,
        AVG(price) AS avg_price,
        seller_id
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY seller_id
")
```

Combining into one dataset
```{r freight_rvw}
seller_summary <- sellers_revenue |>
left_join(freight, by = 'seller_id') |>
left_join(reviews, by = 'seller_id') |>
left_join(order_items, by = 'seller_id')

saveRDS(seller_summary, "rds/seller_summary.rds")

nrow(seller_summary)
nrow(sellers_revenue)
```

Monthly revenue by seller group
```{r revenue}
revenue <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp, 'unixepoch') AS order_date,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue,
        top_seller
    FROM order_items AS oi LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN sellers_revenue as sr ON oi.seller_id = sr.seller_id
    GROUP BY order_date, top_seller
")

saveRDS(revenue, "rds/revenue.rds")

num_orders <- dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp, 'unixepoch') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders 
    FROM orders 
    GROUP BY month 
    ORDER BY month
")

saveRDS(num_orders, "rds/num_orders.rds")
```

```{r clean2}
dbDisconnect(con)

```
